# implement-spec ledger — P10.1 the research-task engine

- **Spec:** docs/tickets/P10.1__task-engine.md (cites §33.1/33.3–33.7 of docs/2_canonical_design_spec.md)
- **Base commit:** bc71c0d (P09.1 coverage)
- **Branch:** devin/p10-1-task-engine
- **Package home:** `tasks/` (mirrors P09.1 pattern: pure-Python value objects aligned to the
  existing `research_task` table in `db/deploy/graph_annotations.sql`; reuses
  `inference.coverage.CoverageRecord` for the disposition→coverage bridge).

## Requirements (SIG-TASK-*) — checklist
- [ ] SIG-TASK-001 — every task type declared as data with all 8 fields (task_type, detector,
      priority_fn, closing_condition, assignee_class, effort_estimate, dispositions[], geographic_scope)
- [ ] SIG-TASK-002 — a task type with **no testable closing_condition** MUST NOT register
- [ ] SIG-TASK-005 — lifecycle generated→triaged→claimed→in_progress→submitted→verified→closed + reopened/invalidated
- [ ] SIG-TASK-006 — auto-invalidate when the detector no longer fires (evidence by another route silently closes)
- [ ] SIG-TASK-007 — duplicate suppression by (task_type, subject); claim timeout returns abandoned claims to pool
- [ ] SIG-TASK-008 — disposition vocabulary richer than "done" (8 dispositions)
- [ ] SIG-TASK-009 — resolved_no_evidence_exists writes a CoverageRecord (absence_kind=searched_not_found + sources)
- [ ] SIG-TASK-010 — a local group MAY claim a jurisdiction (visibility/notification/priority); NO exclusivity
- [ ] SIG-TASK-011 — claims expire without renewal; any contributor may work any open task
- [ ] SIG-TASK-012 — no volume leaderboards; recognition qualitative + tied to verified contributions
- [ ] SIG-TASK-013 — task generation rate-limited per subject (one bad entity can't flood the queue)
- [ ] SIG-TASK-014 — SIG-owned local-group registry (name, jurisdiction, url, contact, activity, claimed queues); no external-directory dependency

## Acceptance criteria (from ticket)
- [ ] AC1: task type with no testable closing_condition cannot register — test
- [ ] AC2: tasks auto-invalidate when detector stops firing — test
- [ ] AC3: geographic claims expire without renewal and never grant exclusivity — test
- [ ] AC4: resolved_no_evidence_exists writes a CoverageRecord — test
- [ ] AC5 (phase-gate §51.3): CI green; new reqs have tests; ADR for deviation; traceability updated; risk register updated

## Out of scope (scope-creep guard)
- concrete task-type catalog (§33.2 detectors) — P10.2
- records-request generation / statute templates / CoverageRecord-via-filed-request — P10.3
- CoverageRecord entity + coverage metrics — P09.1 (consumed here)
- contributor UI / review-queue surfaces — P05.2 / P15.x

## Plan — modules in tasks/src/tasks/
- `vocabulary.py` — AssigneeClass, Disposition, EffortEstimate, TaskStatus enums + transition table
- `spec.py` — Detector (versioned), TaskType (the DSL, 8 fields), TaskTypeRegistry (refuses untestable closing_condition) — SIG-TASK-001/002
- `lifecycle.py` — ResearchTask runtime object + state machine, auto-invalidation, TaskPool (dup suppression + claim timeout + per-subject rate limit) — SIG-TASK-005/006/007/013
- `dispositions.py` — disposition→outcome, resolve_no_evidence_exists → CoverageRecord bridge — SIG-TASK-008/009
- `geographic.py` — GeographicClaim (expiry, non-exclusive), GeographicQueue — SIG-TASK-010/011
- `recognition.py` — qualitative recognition tied to verified contributions; no volume leaderboard — SIG-TASK-012
- `groups.py` — LocalGroupRegistry (SIG-owned, in-memory) — SIG-TASK-014
- update `__init__.py` docstring + re-exports; add `sig-inference` dep to tasks/pyproject.toml
- ADR-039; traceability.md P10.1 section; risk_register.md Phase 10 section

## Gap table (Phase 4) — all MET
Every SIG-TASK-001/002/005/006/007/008/009/010/011/012/013/014 + AC1–AC5 met with a
cited test (see docs/traceability.md P10.1 section). Out-of-scope items (§33.2 catalog,

Self-review fix: broadened lifecycle transitions (early close for non_actionable/
superseded/deferred; invalidated→reopened so re-detection isn't a dead-end under the
(task_type,subject) uniqueness).
